import gzip
import json
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from lexinform.models import ScannedDocument
from lexinform.services.documents import TextLoader
from tests.fakes import FakeTextExtractor
from tests.harness import World


def test_pending_scan_metadata_size(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    current = World(extractor=FakeTextExtractor('', page_count=30), profile='production', triage=True)
    current.add_bill('3039', 'Projekt ustawy o cudzoziemcach')
    current.run(track=False)
    original = TextLoader.load_scan

    def legacy(loader: TextLoader, url: str, *, cover_letter: bool) -> ScannedDocument | None:
        scan = original(loader, url, cover_letter=cover_letter)
        return scan.model_copy(update={'scan_input': None}) if scan else None

    monkeypatch.setattr(TextLoader, 'load_scan', legacy)
    old = World(extractor=FakeTextExtractor('', page_count=30), profile='production', triage=True)
    old.add_bill('3039', 'Projekt ustawy o cudzoziemcach')
    old.run(track=False)
    assert current.batch.submitted[0].custom_id == old.batch.submitted[0].custom_id
    report = {'scope': 'One pending primary scan in the production-profile World; fake providers only', 'measurements': {}}
    for name, world in [('old', old), ('new', current)]:
        sql = world.repo.dump()
        raw = sql.encode()
        if name == 'new':
            with Path('/Users/sobaleu/projects/lexinform/out/corpus/j055/final-pending.sql').open('x') as saved:
                saved.write(sql)
        path = tmp_path / f'{name}.db'
        with sqlite3.connect(path) as db:
            db.executescript(sql)
            assert db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone() == ('ok',)
        report['measurements'][name] = {'sql_bytes': len(raw), 'gzip_bytes': len(gzip.compress(raw, mtime=0)), 'sqlite_bytes': path.stat().st_size}
    with Path('/Users/sobaleu/projects/lexinform/out/corpus/j055/state-sizes-final.json').open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(report, stream, indent=2)
